assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities and engineering constraints require official confirmation.
assumptions.impact: No statutory control conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: The submitted overall boundary is a repository-provided provisional rough geometry, not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: All site areas and clipped design geometry must be recalculated after official boundary replacement.

assumptions.statement: Three key-area polygons are rough provisional locations inferred from announced names, order and approximate areas.
assumptions.impact: They cannot identify parcels, existing projects or demolition targets.

assumptions.statement: Compute, crowd, queue, robot and event capacity thresholds are not present in the public package.
assumptions.impact: Thresholds remain pending field baselines, operator agreement and independent review.

assumptions.statement: Building ownership, condition, floor area, height and heritage status are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: Building retention, adaptation and demolition decisions remain conceptual.

assumptions.statement: Station flows, signals, curb demand, fire access and robot operating data are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: Routes show redundancy intent, not approved transport engineering.

assumptions.statement: Drainage, tree, utility and thermal baselines are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: Green/public-space geometry does not assert engineering capacity.

assumptions.statement: Formal heritage extents, view corridors and conservation requirements are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: All interventions near heritage require specialist review.
